entities.summary: Kevin Charles Dean is an American former professional ice hockey player and is the current Assistant coach for the Vancouver Canucks in the National Hockey League (NHL). Dean played seven seasons in the NHL for the New Jersey Devils, Atlanta Thrashers, Dallas Stars, and Chicago Blackhawks.
